market_context.rationale_en: Although market shows daily bounce of +1~1.6%, technical foundation remains weak: large-cap breadth only 30.77%, KOSDAQ 20-day cumulative −0.35% ongoing, foreign investors in both held stocks showing consecutive selling (ISC 4-day, IOTechnics 1-day). Current bounce under high volatility (annualized +80%) appears as technical rebound; despite AI semiconductor demand signals, flows are institutional-driven and trend reversal unconfirmed. Therefore reduce or halt new purchases next trading day while awaiting foreign inflow reversal and market breadth improvement.
